Class PreLobbyModel

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.preLobby.PreLobbyModel
public class PreLobbyModel extends Object
Entry point for the server's pre-lobby business logic and session coordination.

This model class handles client requests before they transition into a specific lobby or match controller. It coordinates user authentication, lobby list queries, lobby creation, and lobby joining checks.

The model acts as a pure MVC component, validating requests against the shared registry ServerSessionRegistry and directly pushing updates or unicast errors to the connected client Listener interfaces.

    • authenticate

      public boolean authenticate(String sessionId, String nickname)
      Authenticates a client session with a unique nickname.

      If authentication is successful, the nickname is registered in the central session registry and a success payload is sent to the client. If authentication fails (e.g., the nickname is already taken or invalid), an error payload is sent.

      Parameters:
      sessionId - the unique identifier of the client session
      nickname - the nickname chosen by the user
      Returns:
      true if the authentication succeeded, false otherwise

    • createLobby

      public Lobby createLobby(String sessionId, int chosenCapacity, TotemColor totemColor)
      Creates a new lobby with the requested player capacity, registers the host, and reserves the host's selected totem color.

      This method ensures the requesting session is eligible to enter a lobby, resolves its authenticated nickname, creates the lobby domain aggregate in the session registry, registers the creator's listener as an observer on the lobby, and returns the new lobby instance. The totem color is passed to the lobby constructor so the host is already associated with a color before any lobby update payload is emitted.

      Parameters:
      sessionId - the unique identifier of the client session requesting creation
      chosenCapacity - the maximum player capacity of the new lobby
      totemColor - the totem color selected by the host while creating the lobby
      Returns:
      the newly created Lobby instance, or null if creation failed

    • joinLobbyValidation

      public boolean joinLobbyValidation(String sessionId, int lobbyId)
      Validates if a client session is permitted to join the specified lobby.

      Performs checks to assert that:

      • The session is not already associated with any lobby;
      • The session has authenticated and has an active nickname;
      • The target lobby exists;
      • The user nickname is not registered in another active lobby;
      • The target lobby is in a joinable status.
      Parameters:
      sessionId - the unique identifier of the client session attempting to join
      lobbyId - the identifier of the target lobby to join
      Returns:
      true if all validation checks pass, false otherwise (triggers an error payload unicast)
